Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting. Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks. Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies. Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners. Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification. Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes. Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies. Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback. Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery. Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience. Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery. Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly. Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams. The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget. Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility. Especially Valuable Experience Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup. Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time. Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring. For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives. The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team. Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery. Close collaboration with startup leadership. The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops. Remote Working Arrangement Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results. Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities. A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes. Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables. Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account. Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

review_candidates.description: Summary Position Summary Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients strengthen technology resilience and recovery capabilities across complex enterprise environments. As a Senior Consultant, you will support clients in identifying resilience risks, designing recovery strategies, and implementing solutions that improve preparedness for cyber incidents, operational disruptions, and technology failures. You will work across infrastructure, cloud, backup, and recovery domains to help organizations improve operational continuity and recovery readiness. Work you'll do As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for… Conduct technology resilience risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, technical risks, and single points of failure across enterprise environments Design and implement cyber resilience, disaster recovery, incident response, and business continuity solutions aligned to client requirements Design, build, and maintain isolated recovery environments and support recovery of critical workloads, including applications, databases, and directory services Assess infrastructure, application, network, storage, and cloud environments to improve resilience architecture, backup integrity, and recovery readiness Lead recovery testing, simulation exercises, runbook development, and client preparedness activities across resilience programs The team Cyber Defense & Resilience teams help clients defend against sophisticated threats by transforming security operations, leveraging technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence for continuous monitoring and rapid incident response. review_candidates.title: Senior Engineer, Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: About ThredUp ThredUp is transforming resale with technology and a mission to inspire the world to think secondhand first. By making it easy to buy and sell secondhand, ThredUp has become one of the world's largest online resale platforms for apparel, shoes and accessories. Sellers love ThredUp because we make it easy to clean out their closets and unlock value for themselves or for the charity of their choice while doing good for the planet. Buyers love shopping value, premium and luxury brands all in one place, at up to 90% off estimated retail price. Our proprietary operating platform is the foundation for our managed marketplace and consists of distributed processing infrastructure, proprietary software and systems and data science expertise. With ThredUp’s Resale-as-a-Service, some of the world's leading brands and retailers are leveraging our platform to deliver customizable, scalable resale experiences to their customers. ThredUp has processed over 172 million unique secondhand items from 55,000 brands across 100 categories. By extending the life cycle of clothing, ThredUp is changing the way consumers shop and ushering in a more sustainable future for the fashion industry. Recognized on TIME Most Influential Companies of 2023, Digiday's WorkLife 50 2023, TIME's Best Inventions of 2022, and Lattice's People Success Awards 2022. How You Will Make An Impact As a Senior Engineer, Infrastructure, you will design, build, and evolve the core infrastructure that powers ThredUP, with a particular focus on the reliability, performance, and operability of our database estate. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you’ll lead cross-team initiatives and partner with stakeholders to ensure our systems are scalable, cost-effective, and secure. This is an infrastructure-first role for an engineer who is equally comfortable owning production AWS Aurora (MySQL, PostgreSQL). You’ll spend most of your time on cloud-native infrastructure, orchestration, and automation, while serving as the team’s go-to person for database operations, performance tuning, and safe schema evolution. You will play a key role in defining our technical direction and ensuring our platform enables the rapid growth of our marketplace. In This Role You'll Get To Scope & Impact Lead or significantly contribute to medium-to-large infrastructure projects crossing multiple engineering teams. Serve as a domain expert in cloud infrastructure, orchestration, observability, and platform automation, and as the team’s primary owner of database reliability and performance. Ensure ThredUP’s infrastructure evolves to support scale, resilience, and developer productivity. Technical Execution Architect and implement highly available, secure, and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), and Terraform. Drive improvements in CI/CD, observability, networking, and security across the platform. Provide high-quality, impactful technical contributions across infrastructure projects, setting engineering standards. Participate in and lead design reviews, providing constructive feedback and driving engineering excellence. Database Engineering Operate, monitor, and tune AWS Aurora and RDS clusters (MySQL and PostgreSQL), including parameter groups, maintenance, minor/major upgrades, and point-in-time restores. Own HA and replication behavior: respond to failovers, work with cluster vs. instance endpoints, and run the checks required before promoting a reader to writer. Triage and resolve CPU/IO/locking/replication incidents; analyze slow query logs and EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans to produce immediate mitigations and long-term fixes. Plan and execute zero-downtime schema changes with safe rollback paths (online DDL, gh-ost / pt-online-schema-change, pg_repack, logical replication, trigger-based backfills). Partner with application teams to remove N+1 queries, tune indexes, and rewrite inefficient predicates; design partitioning and retention for high-write tables. Design, execute, and regularly validate backup and disaster-recovery procedures. Ownership Act as an expert in infrastructure design, performance, and operations across multiple systems and services. Promote shared ownership of infrastructure by driving documentation, tooling, and process improvements. Monitor and optimize system performance, ensuring reliability while protecting teams from burnout. Leadership & Collaboration Build relationships with engineering teams, product managers, and cross-functional partners to ensure infrastructure supports company goals. Contribute to defining strategic technical direction, setting infrastructure roadmaps, and guiding prioritization. Advocate for best practices in reliability, security, and cost management. Ensure knowledge is shared within the team, reducing single points of failure. What We Are Looking For 6+ years of relevant industry experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Hands-on experience operating MySQL and PostgreSQL in production (Aurora/RDS preferred), including indexing strategies, transactions, locking/MVCC, and performance tuning. Demonstrated experience performing zero-downtime schema changes with safe rollbacks. Proven track record of designing and scaling infrastructure for distributed, service-oriented architectures. Expertise in AWS (EKS, RDS, IAM, cost optimization). Proficiency with Kubernetes and Terraform. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD – one or more). Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar), including slow query and error log analysis. Ability to diagnose connectivity issues affecting database access (security groups, VPC routes/TGW, VPN, DNS). Scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar). Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Additional Skills That Are a Plus Experience with Teleport (or similar DB proxying) and IAM DB authentication. Experience tuning Postgres autovacuum and designing partition-based retention policies. Terraform/Terragrunt module design for RDS/Aurora clusters and snapshot restores. Familiarity with service mesh (Istio) and edge/WAF tooling (Cloudflare). Familiarity with data infrastructure (Airflow, Databricks) and messaging/streaming systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, DynamoDB, MongoDB). Knowledge of network security, vulnerability management, and incident response best practices. Experience with Rollbar or centralized logging pipelines. Experience in fintech, testing automation, and/or compliance-heavy environments (GDPR, SOC2). Prior leadership in scaling platforms for e-commerce or high-growth startups. What We Offer Monthly allowance for insurance/education ($200 gross). 50% paid sabbatical after 3 year anniversary. Paid parental leave for new mothers and fathers. IT Kit. We believe diversity, inclusion and belonging is key for our team At ThredUp, our mission has been built on extending the lives of millions of unique clothing items. Much like our inventory, we are proud to have fostered a workplace that is one-of-a-kind. As a company focused on diversity, inclusion and belonging, we are committed to ensuring our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work every day. A unique perspective is critical to solving complex problems and inspiring a new generation to think secondhand first. Be you. If you are a candidate with a disability and have a reasonable accommodation request for the job application process, please email disabilitysupport@ThredUp.com the specific details of your disability related accommodation request. This email address is reserved for candidates with disabilities only. General application inquiries will not receive a response.

review_candidates.description: We’re AD/01, the tech studio that builds the future of food retail. Whether it’s in-store aisles, online baskets, or behind-the-scenes operations, we innovate the daily food experiences for farmers and families, grandmas and greengrocers, and pickers and packers alike. We’re part of the Ahold Delhaize network, one of the world’s largest global food retail groups and a leader in both supermarkets and e-commerce. With 19 strong local brands in Europe, the United States, and Indonesia, we create a meaningful difference for our customers, our people, and the world around us. And we’re looking for the freshest minds excited to create the recipe for change. Your new role and environment. As a DevOps Engineer within the BeCSE Network Engineering team, you will play a key role in modernizing and automating our network infrastructure across the region. You will be responsible for building scalable, secure, and resilient network solutions, leveraging infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and CI/CD practices to drive efficiency and reliability in both on-premises and cloud environments. You will collaborate closely with engineering, cloud, and security teams, and represent BeCSE (Belgium, Greece, Romania, Serbia, and Czech Republic) in cross-functional groups such as the Architecture SIG and other engineering initiatives. Our organization is undergoing a major infrastructure transformation aligned with a cloud-first and automation-driven strategy. You will contribute to the evolution of our network architecture to support agile, scalable, and secure services for the enterprise. Key responsibilities of your role. Deliver and manage network infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) You’ll design, provision, and manage on-premises and cloud-based networking components using tools like Terraform and Ansible, ensuring scalable and secure deployment processes. Automate network operations and deployments You’ll build automation scripts and CI/CD pipelines to enable consistent, repeatable, and auditable network changes across environments. Support the integration of network and security services You’ll collaborate with security and platform teams to integrate advanced technologies such as firewalls, ZTNA, and network monitoring into enterprise infrastructure. Contribute to network modernization and cloud adoption You’ll support the migration from legacy infrastructure toward software-defined networking and cloud-native solutions, aligned with our cloud-first strategy. Collaborate across teams in Agile environments You’ll engage with product and platform teams to understand requirements and deliver network services as part of Agile delivery cycles. What’s in it for you? We ask a lot. (We’re looking for the best, after all). But we offer a lot, too. So, what do we have in store for you? We offer flexible hours and a hybrid working model, allowing you to work both from home and at the office. We provide competitive benefits to support health, well-being and your professional growth. At AD01 we welcome everyone, just the way you are, and encourage individual growth with valuable opportunities and a worldwide across-brand network. Requirements. We think you’ll be best geared for success if you can meet the following requirements: Bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent experience Minimum 3-5 years of experience in DevOps environment Design, develop and maintain automation solutions to streamline infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines and operational processes. Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines Scripting experience (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development practices Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills Experience in Agile environments is a plus Fluent in English (written and spoken) Familiarity with cloud networking in Azure or other cloud platforms Network and security platforms experience would be a plus (Fortinet, Zscaler, Cisco, F5) It goes without saying that so-called ‘soft skills’ are just as important as their ‘hard’ cousins. If you feel like you might not tick all the boxes but have the skills and personality we’re looking for, then please also apply now! Got questions? Don’t be shy. Ramona Stan, at ramonageorgiana.stan@ad01.com, has answers. We accept everyone for who they are.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, security, and performance of cloud platform services supporting critical business applications. You will work closely with architects, platform managers, application teams, and service providers to maintain reliable operations across Azure and hybrid infrastructure environments. As part of the cloud transformation journey, you will contribute to migration initiatives, automation efforts, and operational excellence programs aimed at increasing platform reliability, transparency, and efficiency. Main Tasks: Operate, monitor, and maintain Azure infrastructure services, ensuring high availability and operational stability. Manage and support core Azure services, including Compute, Storage, Networking, Backup, and Monitoring solutions. Monitor platform health and performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and other operational tools. Respond to incidents, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolution activities to minimize service disruptions. Perform patch management, backup verification, recovery testing, and disaster recovery support activities. Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives across Azure and hybrid infrastructure environments. Contribute to infrastructure automation and standardization efforts using Infrastructure as Code and operational scripting tools. Collaborate with architecture, security, and platform teams to implement operational improvements and best practices. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base articles. Participate in root cause analysis activities and drive continuous service improvement initiatives.
